scope: Two sequential fresh-context samples before then after on this Linux machine in software Chromium; adaptive settle replaces the previous fixed-delay diagnostic. This is a bounded diagnostic, not Mac/hardware FPS certification.
tradeoff: More geometry, per-location lights and 2048 shadow map add active render work and initial software-WebGL startup cost. There is still no continuous rendering or shadow recalculation at idle. No textures, postprocessing render targets or remote asset requests were introduced.
